notes: The gemma-4-e4b-it text with two additions: one blank line, and at the generation prompt, when thinking is not enabled, an empty thought channel (<|channel>thought newline <channel|>) so the model answers without reasoning. review.means: A person read the whole template text at the pinned revision and confirmed that it only lays out the conversation it is given: it adds no instruction to the model beyond the publisher's own default system prompt and tool scaffolding, no branch adds text when a message contains a particular string, and it reaches nothing but the documented chat-template variables and filters. Byte identity with the upstream file and Socair's chat-template check are mechanical checks, listed under checks; they are not the review.
